name: Rise of the Forsaken Consort
overview:
Ling Zhi Yan transmigrates into the body of a foolish and dim-witted princess consort. Upon waking, she faces humiliation from a concubine and disdain from her husband, the prince. With thunderous methods, she punishes the insolent servants, uses family rules to suppress Yu Lan Shang, and even disguises herself as a man to investigate power outside the residence—catching the attention and suspicion of Sheng Ao Yang.

She originally intended to swiftly deal with the inner-court women, leave the prince’s manor, and cultivate her own power to carve out a future in this new world. Unexpectedly, the once-disliked Ling Zhi Yan becomes the coveted prize that royal princes fight over.
